propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which is not caught by existing urllib.error.HTTPError handlers in core reconciler modules, causing exceptions to escape instead of degrading softly

outbound_differ._safe_get_issue fails to classify remotely-deleted issues (404 responses) on DC because it only handles urllib.error.HTTPError and URLError, not JIRAError, breaking deletion detection silently
The port declares no neutral exception contract, forcing core modules to reference transport-specific types (urllib.error.HTTPError) which leak Cloud implementation details into vendor-neutral code
BackendHTTPError subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError allows existing catch clauses and .code access to work without editing core modules, preserving Cloud path integrity
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving HTTP status codes for proper error classification in core logic
